quizName:
Hardest Questions in California
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Get ready for traffic to merge into your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get ready for traffic to merge into your lane.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right. You should prepare to let them merge safely.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction at this location.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers about traffic laws. This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about situations ahead. This sign warns you that pedestrians may be crossing here.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to what is immediately ahead. This sign warns that another road crosses the highway ahead.

questions.question: Which of the following is both dangerous and illegal while driving?

options.text: Wearing a headset that covers both ears
Having one or more interior lights on
Using cruise control on residential streets

questions.correctAnswerText: Wearing a headset that covers both ears
questions.explanation: Do not wear headsets or earplugs in both ears while driving. It is illegal. You must hear all hazards around you.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Watch for people crossing your path.

questions.explanation: This orange warning sign tells you that roadwork is coming. Stay alert for temporary traffic control devices in the work zone.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a left turn. It is unsafe and illegal to turn left where this sign is posted.

questions.question: If your vehicle has both a lap belt and a separate shoulder belt, you must:

options.text: Use both the lap and shoulder belts.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both the lap and shoulder belts.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle has both a lap belt and a separate shoulder belt, you must use both.

questions.question: If you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:
questions.explanation: When you see an aggressive driver, the safest choice is to get out of their way. Do not try to compete with other drivers.

questions.question: If a traffic light is green but a police officer signals for you to stop, you should:

options.text: Do what the vehicle in front of you does.

questions.explanation: You must obey a police officer's instructions, even if they conflict with traffic signals, signs, or road markings.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Round signs always mean a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This sign indicates a:
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings warn about hazards ahead. Round signs are only used to warn about railroad crossings.

questions.question: At a crosswalk:

options.text: Construction workers must yield to you.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians have the right-of-way at crossings. You must stop for pedestrians in a crosswalk, whether it is marked or not.

questions.question: If a truck or bus is making a right turn where you also want to turn right, you should:

options.text: Turn quickly before the truck or bus does.
Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning.
Squeeze between the truck or bus and the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the truck or bus finishes turning.
questions.explanation: Do not try to squeeze between a turning truck or bus and the curb. This can cause a serious crash. Wait until the truck or bus completes its turn.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign shows that turns in the direction of the arrow are prohibited. In this case, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: You must file an accident report in California when:

options.text: Your vehicle fails a smog test.
You are in a collision and someone is injured.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are in a collision and someone is injured.
questions.explanation: Report a collision to DMV within 10 days if anyone was injured. You must report it whether or not you caused the collision, even if it happened on private property.

questions.question: Which driving skills are affected by alcohol and/or drugs?
questions.explanation: Alcohol and drugs harm many driving skills. They slow reaction time, reduce coordination, decrease alertness, and make it hard to concentrate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.explanation: This sign is posted on one-way streets and roads where you cannot enter. You may see this sign if you try to enter an expressway ramp going the wrong way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Right turn on red light permitted with caution.
All traffic must turn right at next intersection.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: If you reach a railroad crossing with lowered gates and flashing lights, you should:

options.text: Drive around the gates if you do not see a train.
Stop completely behind the gates. Wait for the tracks to clear. Then proceed when the gates are raised.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely behind the gates. Wait for the tracks to clear. Then proceed when the gates are raised.
questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when signs, lights, or flaggers warn you of a train. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: An eight-sided red sign means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to places where animals, people, and vehicles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reserved parking for persons with disabilities.
questions.explanation: This sign shows parking spaces reserved for vehicles with disability license plates, disabled veteran plates, or disabled parking permits.

questions.question: Your cell phone rings while you are driving and you do not have a hands-free device. What should you do?

options.text: Answer the call because it may be an emergency.
Let the call go to voicemail.
Check who is calling before you answer.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the call go to voicemail.
questions.explanation: Do not use your cell phone without a hands-free device while driving. For drivers under 18, using any cell phone while driving is illegal except in emergencies. Even with a hands-free device, let calls go to voicemail to avoid distractions.

questions.question: Where is the safest place for children age 12 and under to sit in a vehicle with airbags?

options.text: The bed of a pickup truck.

questions.explanation: Airbags can seriously hurt children. Children age 12 or under should always sit in the back seat of a vehicle with airbags.

questions.question: If you feel drowsy while driving, what should you do?
questions.explanation: If you feel tired while driving, stop at the nearest rest stop or service area to rest, nap, stretch, or let someone else drive. Caffeine pills and energy drinks are not good replacements for sleep and may make driving more dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn. You cannot turn around and go in the opposite direction at an intersection where this sign is posted.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, what should you do?

options.text: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop and rest or let someone else drive.
questions.explanation: To avoid tired driving, take breaks every hour during long trips. Share driving with another person so you can sleep while they drive.

questions.question: When can you drive in a bike lane?

options.text: 30 minutes after sunset or 30 minutes before sunrise
On foggy days when visibility is low

questions.explanation: When turning right, you can enter the bike lane only 200 feet before the corner or driveway. Do not drive in the bike lane at any other time.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell drivers about traffic laws and must be followed. Where this sign is posted, right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns of a steep hill ahead. Slow down and shift to a lower gear to control your speed and protect your brakes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a line through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: You want to turn right at the corner. A pedestrian with a guide dog is at the corner ready to cross in front of you. What should you do?

options.text: Turn off your engine until the person crosses.
Tell the pedestrian when to cross.
Wait until the person crosses the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until the person crosses the street.
questions.explanation: Pedestrians using guide dogs or white canes must have the right-of-way at all times.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: A round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. This sign is posted a few hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: All roads are slippery and dangerous when wet. This sign warns of conditions that can cause you to lose control of your car. Slow down on wet pavement because it takes longer to stop.
